_source: https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/tsv/tables/lv.tsv + launch.tsv; GCAT (J. McDowell, planet4589.org/space/gcat), CC BY 4.0
_derivedFrom: SpaxeX src/data/extended/gcat-rockets.json (534 rows), trimmed to the fields the demo needs; only rows with launches >= 1 and both length_m and diameter_m (so a silhouette can be drawn). flags (GCAT uncertainty marks) kept where present. referenceId marks a GCAT row that is the same vehicle as a reference-rockets.json record whose manufacturer liftoff figures differ from GCAT's (Falcon 9 FT5, Falcon Heavy); Saturn V is not linked because that record is a rounded education-page figure and GCAT's is closer to the AS-506 actuals.
